invoices.title: Customer invoices
invoices.description: Your validated invoices and the ones being prepared.
invoices.emptyDescription: Make an invoice from an order, or directly.

invoice.issueCreditNote: Return of goods (make a credit note)
invoice.draftNotice: This invoice is being prepared: it has no number yet, the stock has not moved and it is not in the accounts. Click “Validate” when it is ready.

payment.title: Receive a payment
payment.referencePlaceholder: Number of the cheque, bank transfer or transaction…
payment.savedOffline: Payment kept on this device (no internet).
payment.savedOfflineDescription: It will be added to the invoice when internet comes back.

creditNote.title: Return of goods (credit note)
creditNote.description: A validated invoice cannot be changed. To correct or cancel it, you make a credit note: it cancels the whole invoice.
creditNote.reasonPlaceholder: The customer brought the goods back, mistake on the invoice…
creditNote.restock: Put the items back in stock
creditNote.issued: Credit note made: the invoice is cancelled.

creditNotes.title: Returns of goods (credit notes)
creditNotes.description: Cancelled or corrected invoices, with the items put back in stock.
creditNotes.emptyDescription: To make a credit note, open a validated invoice.

invoiceForm.title: New invoice
invoiceForm.description: Until it is validated, the invoice changes nothing. When you validate it, the stock goes down.
invoiceForm.warehouseHint: The warehouse the items leave from.
invoiceForm.draftSavedOffline: Invoice kept on this device (no internet).
invoiceForm.draftSavedOfflineDescription: It will be sent when internet comes back.
invoiceForm.savedOffline: Invoice {{number}} kept on this device (no internet).
invoiceForm.savedOfflineDescription: It will be validated when internet comes back.
invoiceForm.validated: Invoice {{number}} validated. The stock is updated.
